name: Chuunibyou Izumi Kako Monogatari ~Maou Tensei System~
original_name: 中二病泉過去物語 ～魔王転生システム～
source:
"You shouldn't leave the room big brother"

Your memory is fuzzy...
He's my younger brother. I'm sick and being cared for
...? Something doesn't seem right.
I feel like I've forgotten something

"Big brother. I love you"

A super-short fantasy BL investigation game,
depicting our protagonist Izumi, and his brother Cool.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ247172.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“哥哥，你不能离开房间。”

你的记忆模糊不清…
他是我的弟弟。我生病了，正在接受照料。
…？总觉得哪里不对劲。
我好像忘记了什么。

“哥哥，我爱你。”

这是一款超短篇奇幻BL推理游戏，
讲述主角Izumi与他的弟弟Cool。
